submitted_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS genre_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Metal' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01';
validated_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS genre_revenue FROM public.invoice_line AS il JOIN public.invoice AS i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.genre AS g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Metal' AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)
